item.title: Karnataka SEC to use ballot papers for B'luru civic polls; elections after May 25
item.description: Union Minister for Food and Parliamentary Affairs Pralhad Joshi has strongly criticised the Karnataka Congress-led government for insisting on using ballot papers for local body elections, calling it a tragedy and a matter of shame.

item.title: Iconic Italian fashion designer Valentino Garavani passes away at 93; celebs mourn loss
item.description: Internationally acclaimed couturier, Valentino, passed away at his residence in Rome and as history stands testament was known to have designed for famous women like Lady Diana, Julia Roberts, Jacqueline Kennedy and several others.

item.title: MM Keeravaani to perform Vande Mataram with 2,500 artists at Republic Day parade
item.description: MM Keeravaani says that he is honoured and privileged to have composed the music for Vande Mataram for the 26th January Republic Day Parade.

item.title: Trump links Nobel Peace Prize snub to security push over Greenland
item.description: The disclosure has intensified tensions between the US and European allies, with Trump questioning Denmark's claim over Greenland and framing the issue as a national security necessity. European leaders have urged de-escalation, while Denmark and Greenland have rejected US demands, amid growing protests on the island and heightened military and diplomatic activity around the Arctic territory.

item.title: Silver prices touch fresh record as safe-haven demand rises; gold hovers near peak
item.description: Gold also hovered near all-time highs, supported by geopolitical uncertainty, expectations of US rate cuts and concerns over the Federal Reserve's independence. While some intraday profit-taking was seen after the sharp rally, analysts said the broader outlook for precious metals remains bullish, driven by safe-haven demand, supply concerns and strong industrial consumption, particularly for silver.

item.title: Delhi air quality shows slight improvement; AQI still in 'very poor' zone
item.description: Delhi-NCR saw a slight improvement in air quality on Tuesday, with the AQI recorded at 397, placing it in the 'very poor' category, according to CPCB. Despite the marginal improvement, smog continues to blanket the region, reducing visibility. Authorities have enforced GRAP Phase 4 measures, including vehicle checks and restrictions on construction activities, as pollution levels remain severe in several areas.

item.title: Stock market decline continues over weak global cues, FII selling
item.description: Persistent selling by foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) also weighed on the market sentiment. Around 9.30 am, Sensex lost 275 points, or 0.33 per cent to reach 82,971 and Nifty declined 91 points, or 0.36 per cent to 25,494.

item.title: Farah Khan talks about her next film, says she will only make it with Shah Rukh Khan
item.description: Shah Rukh Khan and Farah Khan's collaboration so far has been cheered on by the audience, even if they were not always critically acclaimed. Only time will tell what the two of them will bring forth at the theatres for their fans

item.title: Dhandoraa review by Jr NTR: Thought provoking film with outstanding performances
item.description: Junior NTR impressed with Dhandoraa, which he describes as a thought provoking and powerful film with outstanding performances.
